Tips for a Smooth Streaming Experience

Stable Internet Connection

Buffering can disrupt your enjoyment of live sports, so ensure your connection is reliable. A steady broadband or 5GHz Wi-Fi network helps maintain continuous 1080p playback.

Keep Your Browser Updated

Modern streaming protocols perform best on modern browser engines like Chrome, Firefox, Safari, or Edge.

Close Background Bandwidth Apps

Free up system and network resources by closing heavy background downloads, game updates, or streaming tabs.
